🆕 New (Published: October 27, 2026)

The Citizen Activity Center will hold two winter events.

【Mikatsu Winter 2026】
Date and time: Sunday, December 6, 10:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
Venue: Citizen Activity Center
Local groups and individuals will perform music, singing, dance, and more, offer workshops, and sell items.

At the same venue, a beginner smartphone class "LINE App Workshop" will also be held.
Date and time: Sunday, December 6, 1:30 p.m.–3:30 p.m.
Venue: Citizen Activity Center Conference Room
Capacity: 15 people (first-come, first-served)
To apply: Call the Citizen Activity Center starting Sunday, November 8.
※Please bring your own smartphone.

【Christmas Concert】
Date and time: Saturday, December 19, 2:00 p.m.–3:00 p.m.
Venue: Multi-purpose Hall
Performer: S Quartet Orgel
Capacity: 80 people (first-come, first-served)
To apply: Call the Citizen Activity Center starting Saturday, November 14.
※Please use the City Hall parking lot. Maruhiro Department Store underground parking charges a fee.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jitishinkoka/shiminkatudou/10287.html
